capabilities: Open and edit .hwp and .hwpx files in the vault
Create new HWPX documents from the command palette
Save as HWP or HWPX with pre-save backups and content-loss checks
Link to and embed specific pages of HWP/HWPX documents
Expose a versioned document API to other plugins
extras: Desktop only, with no network requests. Not every HWP/HWPX feature can be edited; some are only preserved and save warnings flag content loss. The user interface is in Korean. Keeps up to three pre-save backups per document, journals unsaved edits across restarts, and offers a setting to keep a document private from AI tools.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit HWP/HWPX (Hangul) documents natively, so users of these formats must leave the app.

relations.evidence: The engine is built from RHWP 0.9.0 with local patches

summary: Editor for Hangul HWP and HWPX documents that parses, lays out and saves files locally via a bundled RHWP WebAssembly engine, with a document API for other plugins.
